name: Sharma Interior
tagline: Modern responsive digital showcase and administrative portal for a Mumbai interior design studio.
description: Production client-facing portfolio platform engineered to showcase architectural renovations, before-and-after project transformations, specialized design services, and promotional consultations with an integrated administrative management panel.
problem: Traditional interior design practices lack interactive, high-performance web showcases to display before-and-after project imagery, detailed project specifications, and centralized client inquiry collection.
solution: Built a responsive, mobile-first single-page application featuring multi-route client navigation, before/after visual showcases, project detail specifications, consultation intake forms, and an administrative dashboard.
metrics_and_highlights: Engineered with React 19 and React Router DOM 7 for client-side navigation across 9 distinct routes.
Integrated dynamic project showcase architecture supporting before-and-after visual inspections, budget tiers, square footage specs, and client feedback.
Architected administrative authentication and dashboard interfaces for project indexing and inquiry management.
Built for performance and rapid delivery using Vite 8 and Tailwind CSS 3.4 with deployment on Vercel.

showcase_and_client_suites: Portfolio gallery with before/after visual toggles and project category sorting
Dynamic project detail routes displaying scope, square footage, budget metrics, and client testimonials
Service catalog highlighting residential living spaces, commercial offices, and modular kitchen solutions
Promotional seasonal offers hub and direct client inquiry intake forms
admin_and_management: Authentication gate (/auth) for studio management and staff verification
Centralized administrative dashboard (/dashboard) for tracking incoming inquiries and curating project assets
Modular data architecture (src/data/index.js) separating styling metadata, project specs, and testimonials
